description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Sales Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Sales Assistant will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Consultor de processos de TI
description:
Contratação temporária (6 meses, podendo ser prorrogado por mais 3)

Atuação remota.

Estamos buscando por um(a) Consultor(a) de Processos Sênior para atuar em um projeto global de melhoria contínua e evolução de sistemas de gestão integrada.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como Product Owner em um sistema de gestão integrado, com foco em qualidade e gestão de incidentes;
  • Conduzir mapeamento de processos e levantamento de requisitos junto aos requisitantes de melhorias;
  • Priorizar backlog e acompanhar o desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e melhorias no sistema;
  • Cobrir temporariamente as atividades de negócios durante licença de colaborador(a);
  • Participar de projetos globais, com interação com stakeholders internacionais.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em consultoria de processos com foco em implementação de sistemas;
  • Vivência como Product Owner e conhecimento em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em gestão da qualidade (certificação não obrigatória);
  • Experiência em projetos globais;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de articulação com áreas de negócio e times técnicos.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para conversação frequente.

title: Administrador Salesforce - Seguradora
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Administrador(a) Salesforce para atuar em uma empresa sólida do segmento de seguros, com o desafio de garantir a gestão, manutenção e evolução da plataforma , apoiando diretamente as áreas de negócio na otimização dos processos e na melhor experiência dos usuários.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Administrar usuários, perfis, papéis e permissões conforme políticas de segurança e compliance.
  • Criar e manter objetos, campos personalizados, relatórios e dashboards para atender às demandas das áreas.
  • Configurar e gerenciar fluxos, regras de validação e automações que otimizem a operação comercial e de atendimento.
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos usuários e acompanhar SLAs de chamados internos .

title: Software Engineering Team Lead
description:
About us

Wallester is a cutting-edge financial technology company that specializes in providing innovative solutions for businesses seeking to modernize their payment systems. By offering white-label card issuance platforms, seamless integration with existing infrastructure, and comprehensive support for both digital and physical cards, Wallester empowers companies to enhance their financial services and customer experience. Recognized as a leader in the FinTech space, Wallester has earned a reputation for its state-of-the-art technology, security, and scalability. Whether you are a startup or an established enterprise, Wallester delivers flexible, reliable solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of the digital economy.


About the role

As a Software Engineering Team Lead at Wallester, you will be responsible for leading a team of engineers and overseeing their work on complex projects. You will plan, organize, and direct the engineering work, ensuring on-time completion and quality outcomes. You will collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to meet project objectives and align engineering goals with business requirements. You will also be involved in developing new processes or procedures for your team, creating training programs, updating job descriptions, or establishing performance metrics.If you are passionate about fintech and payment solutions, have excellent technical skills, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, then this role is for you!


Technology stack

  • Golang
  • gRPC
  • Protocol Buffers
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • JSON REST API
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Linkerd
  • AWS infrastructure
  • Microservice Architecture


What will you do?

  • Guide, coach and grow our team of outstanding Software Engineers
  • Provide technical leadership and direction, bridging the gap between the engineering team and senior management
  • Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to understand project requirements and optimize development resource allocation
  • Manage and prioritize development tasks to meet project deadlines and deliver high-quality results
  • Jump into hands-on development when needed, helping the team in solving ongoing challenges
  • Continuously monitor and evaluate code quality and development output, identifying areas for improvement and working collaboratively to fix defects and issues
  • Actively contribute to adopting best practices in Software Engineering, improvement of processes, and team culture


What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience in software development using any OOP language (C# / Java / PHP / etc)
  • 2+ years of experience in leading a software engineering team
  • Experience with microservices architecture, REST API, RPC, PostgreSQL, and Docker
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire team members
  • You have good English and communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, where you can adapt to changing priorities and deadlines
  • Proficient in Agile methodologies and Scrum framework
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Demonstrated experience in mentoring and coaching team members
  • Experience in working with cloud platforms (Azure / GCP / AWS)


Nice to have

  • Familiarity with DevOps principles and practices
  • Knowledge of CI/CD best practices and technologies for software engineering and delivery
  • Experience in test methodologies and frameworks
  • Experience in financial software development
  • Knowledge of security best practices and standards (OWASP, PCI DSS)
  • Also, a spark in the eyes is always a plus!


We offer

  • Competitive salary
  • The chance to work as part of a highly motivated and talented team
  • Development and career opportunities
  • Supportive and caring Leadership
  • A modern office in the center of Tallinn
  • Fresh fruit, sweets, drinks, and treats
  • Sports compensation
  • Great Team events
  • Free Parking

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer owns the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and influences the technical direction of their team. They will work closely with Product and Engineering partners in the development of the solution.


  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Develop and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and make informed decisions.
  • Employ state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key components of systems and solutions, ensuring that they meet the needs of the business.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders in the development of data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor junior team members to help establish team domain expertise.
  • Contribute to the companys intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Masters Degree or PhD in CS / ML or related field
  • 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design
  • Experience in at least one of these domains: price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection and authentication, marketing
  • Extensive experience in scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)
  • Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure

Fluency in Python, SQL


Preferred Requirements:

  • PhD preferred (CS, ML, AI or related field)
  • Background in applying ML techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused and passionate about delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to lead and inspire a team.

title: Account Executive
description:
Near is a startup focused on bridging the gap between remote Latin American talent and companies hiring in the US and abroad. Our team spans 20+ members across four different countries. We've landed numerous great customers and have helped hundreds of people from LatAm improve their lives and wallets with jobs at US companies.


We're looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Account Executive who is autonomous, creative, and enterprising to join our team. This is a financially rewarding opportunity with a highly competitive compensation structure – uncapped commission. If you can source and qualify leads effectively, you'll make a lot of money.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute plans to achieve sales targets
  • Expand revenue originated from existing accounts
  • Create new opportunities through outbound prospecting.
  • Close inbound leads
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships
  • Leverage our existing network to get referrals
  • Understand industry-specific landscapes and trends.
  • Become an expert in the staffing industry.


Qualifications:

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Native-like English level
  • Demonstrated ability to problem solve and effectively manage time.
  • A proactive mindset: always pursuing your next goal.
  • Motivated by commission and career growth.
  • Track record of exceeding quota as SDR.


Traits that Would Make You a Strong Fit:

  • Proactive.
  • Optimistic and positive.
  • Intense, driving, and impatient (with regard to results and getting work done).
  • Pay attention to detail when necessary.
  • High EQ – can read the room and connect with people
  • Responds empathetic to others.
  • Follow-through skills.
  • Accountability


Benefits :

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Uncapped commission – the more you close, the higher your commission will be.
  • Results-focused role and team. No BS. No unnecessary processes and bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to grow and work on larger and more complex deals.
  • A team with a great culture.
  • Join a team of high-performers.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
Help more patients access life-changing clinical trials by building the team that makes it possible.


About Denali Health

Denali Health is a fast-growing clinical research network focused on quality data, accelerated enrollment, and operational efficiency. The foundation of our work and approach is based on the talented people (heroes) that help


The Role: Talent Acquisition Lead


You’ll lead full-cycle recruiting across site and central teams—PIs, Sub-Is, CRCs, Regulatory/SSU, QA, Site Directors, and central ops. You’ll partner closely with Operations and Study Start-Up to anticipate demand and build pipelines that let us activate sites quickly. You’ll own sourcing strategy, candidate experience, and the data that guides both. You’ll be hands-on with hard-to-fill roles while standing up repeatable systems for scale. 


What You’ll Do

  • Source niche clinical talent (PIs, Sub-Is, CRCs, Regulatory, QA, central ops)
  • Build and execute hiring plans with executive leadership; define role scopes, competencies, and sourcing plan.
  • Develop industry relationships that become a source of high quality referrals
  • Reduce time-to-hire and time-to-site-activation 
  • Own candidate experience end-to-end—fast feedback, transparent timelines, respectful declines.
  • Conduct interviews to assess competence 
  • Coordinate credentialing and GCP/ICH verification steps with QA/Compliance for a smooth start.

description:
Bitunix is expanding across LATAM region and building a team of professional Business Development Managers who will play a key role in driving user growth and becoming essential partners in the company’s success.

title: GIS Python Developer
description:
GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python ) and integrating them into Esri’s ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop QA/QC Scripts:
  • Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as:
  • Missing or invalid geometry
  • Polygon overlaps or gaps
  • Attribute inconsistencies
  • Coordinate system mismatches
  • Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly)


  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager:
  • Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling:
  • Automatic validation after data edits or updates
  • Flagging and reporting of errors for correction
  • Consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards


  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance:
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.


  • Collaborate Across Teams:
  • Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .
  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .
  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .
  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .
  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.
  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.


What You’ll Achieve

You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

title: Consultor de Implementação Jr
description:
*** A entrevista será conduzida em inglês ***

*** A entrevista será conduzida em inglês ***


A Smart Food Safe é uma empresa canadense com sede em Dorval, Quebec. Especializa-se no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais para a gestão da segurança e qualidade dos alimentos, oferecendo uma plataforma modular que abrange desde o campo até o consumidor final. Seus serviços incluem controle de documentos, rastreabilidade, HACCP, auditorias, gestão de fornecedores, treinamentos e conformidade regulatória.


Atualmente, a Smart Food Safe opera em 28 países distribuídos por seis continentes, atendendo a diversos setores, como agricultura, processamento de alimentos, serviços de alimentação, laboratórios analíticos, produtos naturais para a saúde, farmacêuticos e cosméticos.



Qualificações:

- Habilidades analíticas para avaliar processos de negócios e identificar soluções.

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação para interagir com clientes e ministrar treinamentos.

- Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e eficiente em um ambiente 100% remoto.

- Faculdade em períodos finais.

- Necessário Inglês avançado.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Integração de Clientes

Concluir o processo de integração de novos clientes em até 3 meses, incluindo instalação, configuração e treinamento.


  • Suporte ao Cliente

Responder às perguntas e preocupações dos clientes, coordenando com as equipes de desenvolvimento e controle de qualidade para solucionar problemas e implementar novos recursos.


  • Teste de Aceitação do Usuário

Teste novas versões de módulos antes do lançamento usando casos de uso reais, identifique bugs e comunique atualizações para o cliente.


  • Tradução

Traduza páginas da web, guias do usuário e outros materiais para garantir consistência e uma experiência do usuário localizada.



O que Oferecemos:

- Remuneração em dólares.

- Trabalho 100% remoto com flexibilidade de horários.

- Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, colaborativo e inovador.

- Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional
company: Smart Food Safe : Quality & Food Safety Management Software

title: Desenvolvedor Python - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Desenvolvedor Python - Remoto.

O que oferecemos a você:

  • Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;
  • Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota;
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino;
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas;
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;
  • Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;
  • Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;
  • Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;
  • GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: SR Desenvolvimento Java
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Sênior com sólida experiência em Java , Node.js e Arquiteturas avançadas para integrar nosso time de tecnologia. A pessoa ideal será responsável por desenvolver e manter aplicações web robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance, assim como atuar próximo ao Tech Lead para definições técnicas para o desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar Tech Lead em Definições Técnica: Orientar decisões arquiteturais, definir stack tecnológico e estabelecer padrões de desenvolvimento;
  • Auxiliar Desenvolvimento: Auxiliar em dúvidas tecnicas equipes, conduzir code reviews e desenvolver programadores pleno/júnior;
  • Performance e Escalabilidade: Otimizar aplicações para alta performance, implementar estratégias de cache e load balancing;
  • Segurança Corporativa: Implementar práticas de segurança, auditoria de código e compliance com padrões enterprise;
  • Integração Complexa: Desenvolver integrações críticas com sistemas legados, APIs de terceiros e serviços externos;
  • Disaster Recovery: Projetar estratégias de backup, recuperação e alta disponibilidade;
  • Inovação Técnica: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, POCs e melhorias de processo;
  • Gestão de Incidentes: Auxiliar troubleshooting de problemas críticos em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de Microserviços: Criar e manter APIs REST utilizando Spring Boot e NestJS para sistemas de alta disponibilidade;
  • Integração de Sistemas: Implementar comunicação entre serviços via RabbitMQ, OpenFeign e APIs externas;
  • Documentação: Manter documentação técnica atualizada e especificações de APIs;
  • Testes Automatizados: Desenvolver testes unitários, integração e contratos (PACT) garantindo qualidade do código;
  • Integração de Sistemas: Implementar comunicação entre serviços via RabbitMQ, OpenFeign e APIs externas;
  • Gestão de Dados: Desenvolver soluções com MongoDB, bancos relacionais (JPA/Hibernate) e Redis para cache.


Requisitos

  • Arquitetura Avançada: Domain-Driven Design, Event Sourcing, CQRS, Hexagonal Architecture;
  • Java/Spring Ecosystem: Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Cloud Gateway, Spring Security, WebFlux;
  • Node.js (Avançado), NestJS, Express, Event Loop optimization, clustering;
  • Databases: Modelagem avançada, sharding, replicação, performance tuning;
  • Distributed Systems: Consensus algorithms, CAP theorem, eventual consistency;
  • Cloud Native: AWS/Azure/GCP, Terraform, service mesh, observability;
  • DevOps Avançado: Kubernetes operators, Helm charts, GitOps;
  • Mensageria: RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka;
  • Testes: JUnit, Jest, Mockito, TestContainers
  • Versionamento: Git, GitLab/GitHub.


Diferenciais

  • Big Data: Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch, data streaming;
  • Machine Learning: MLOps, model serving, data pipelines;
  • Blockchain/Web3: Smart contracts, DeFi protocols;
  • Edge Computing: CDN optimization, edge functions.


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

A pessoa ideal será responsável por desenvolver e manter aplicações web robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance, assim como atuar próximo ao Tech Lead para definições técnicas para o desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar Tech Lead em Definições Técnica: Orientar decisões arquiteturais, definir stack tecnológico e estabelecer padrões de desenvolvimento;
  • Auxiliar Desenvolvimento: Auxiliar em dúvidas tecnicas equipes, conduzir code reviews e desenvolver programadores pleno/júnior;
  • Performance e Escalabilidade: Otimizar aplicações para alta performance, implementar estratégias de cache e load balancing;
  • Segurança Corporativa: Implementar práticas de segurança, auditoria de código e compliance com padrões enterprise;
  • Integração Complexa: Desenvolver integrações críticas com sistemas legados, APIs de terceiros e serviços externos;
  • Disaster Recovery: Projetar estratégias de backup, recuperação e alta disponibilidade;
  • Inovação Técnica: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, POCs e melhorias de processo;
  • Gestão de Incidentes: Auxiliar troubleshooting de problemas críticos em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de Microserviços: Criar e manter APIs REST utilizando Spring Boot e NestJS para sistemas de alta disponibilidade;
  • Integração de Sistemas: Implementar comunicação entre serviços via RabbitMQ, OpenFeign e APIs externas;
  • Documentação: Manter documentação técnica atualizada e especificações de APIs;
  • Testes Automatizados: Desenvolver testes unitários, integração e contratos (PACT) garantindo qualidade do código;
  • Integração de Sistemas: Implementar comunicação entre serviços via RabbitMQ, OpenFeign e APIs externas;
  • Gestão de Dados: Desenvolver soluções com MongoDB, bancos relacionais (JPA/Hibernate) e Redis para cache.


Requisitos

  • Arquitetura Avançada: Domain-Driven Design, Event Sourcing, CQRS, Hexagonal Architecture;
  • Java/Spring Ecosystem: Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Cloud Gateway, Spring Security, WebFlux;
  • Node.js (Avançado), NestJS, Express, Event Loop optimization, clustering;
  • Databases: Modelagem avançada, sharding, replicação, performance tuning;
  • Distributed Systems: Consensus algorithms, CAP theorem, eventual consistency;
  • Cloud Native: AWS/Azure/GCP, Terraform, service mesh, observability;
  • DevOps Avançado: Kubernetes operators, Helm charts, GitOps;
  • Mensageria: RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka;
  • Testes: JUnit, Jest, Mockito, TestContainers
  • Versionamento: Git, GitLab/GitHub.


Diferenciais

  • Big Data: Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch, data streaming;
  • Machine Learning: MLOps, model serving, data pipelines;
  • Blockchain/Web3: Smart contracts, DeFi protocols;
  • Edge Computing: CDN optimization, edge functions.

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;

title: SDR/BDR (Outbound | English)
description:
WriteChoice helps SaaS and API-first companies increase product adoption, reduce support tickets, and maximize growth by delivering high-quality documentation portals.


Your Mission:  

As the first line of our global expansion, your mission will be to power our demand generation engine. You'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying the fintech startups that need our solution the most, opening the doors for our CEO to close high-value deals.


Responsibilities:

  • Actively prospect C-level executives (CEOs, CTOs, CPOs) at technology startups (Fintech, SaaS) in the US.
  • Manage the sales funnel and all lead interactions in Pipedrive.
  • Create and execute personalized prospecting cadences via email and LinkedIn.
  • Schedule qualified meetings for the CEO.
  • Work closely with leadership to refine and optimize prospecting processes.


Must-Have:

  • A Drive to Win: You are highly motivated by targets and commissions.
  • Unshakeable Resilience:  You understand that hearing "no" is part of the process and you don't give up easily.
  • Fluent in English: Impeccable writing and speaking skills are essential for communicating with our clients.
  • Organized and Disciplined: You excel at following processes and maintaining a tidy CRM.
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator Experience: Understanding how to leverage its advanced search capabilities, saved lead lists, and personalized outreach functions.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Previous experience with outbound sales in a tech startup (SaaS/Fintech).
  • Experience with Apollo and AI tools like Clay to accelerate lead gen.
  • Previous experience in email outreach.


Hiring Model:  MEI/PJ

Career: Career plan with commissions and progressions

title: Senior Full-stack Developer IV
description:
As a full-stack software engineer IV, you will get the opportunity to work on InComm Product Control (IPC) team. In this role, you will focus on creating, enhancing, and redesigning the applications with the most cutting-edge technologies to provide POS-integrated platform, automated decision-making at POR terminals and business intelligence analytic tools. IPC is a specialized division of InComm that provides product lifecycle tracking and returns management solutions for retailers and manufacturers.


100% Remote + CLT + Benefits (Health Insurance Coverage, Meal Vouchers, Annual Bonuses, and more!)


Responsibilities:

  • Designing, developing, and implementing scalable and robust applications using Java and the Spring framework (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data) and front-end framework like Vue JS.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including stakeholders, QA engineers, and product managers, to analyze issues, define requirements and deliver integrated solutions.
  • Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code, adhering to coding standards and best practices.
  • Creating and performing unit, integration, and system testing to ensure application quality and performance.
  • Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues in existing applications.
  • Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback to peers.
  • Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in the Spring ecosystem and JavaScipt communities.
  • Contributing to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Making technical and team decisions and assuming responsibility for those decisions while keeping management informed
  • Providing direction, motivating, and supporting a small group of individuals to achieve specific goals.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
  • 8+ years of proven experience in developing Java applications (1.8 and above), specifically with the Spring framework and Spring Boot in enterprise level scalable, distributed and fault tolerant environments.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases including SQL, stored procedures, and data modeling with MS SQL and/or Oracle.
  • Advanced knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 and Core JavaScript. Proficiency in at least one of modern front-end frameworks like Angular, React, and/or Vue.
  • Strong understanding of object relational mapping APIs like Hibernate, JPA and/or myBatis.
  • Practical understanding of developing Restful Microservices Services using Spring boot.
  • Proficient in version control, build management, and issue tracking software (i.e. git, Maven, JIRA)
  • Good working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and/or Windows server.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with containerization technologies and continuous delivery tools (e.g., Docker, Jenkins Pipeline, Kubernetes, Istio, ArgoCD and/or Snyk) is preferred.
  • Experience with SQL Sentry Tool, Dynatrace and/or Splunk is beneficial.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshooting issues.
  • Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

title: Senior Full-stack Developer IV
description:
As a full-stack software engineer IV, you will get the opportunity to work on InComm Product Control (IPC) team. In this role, you will focus on creating, enhancing, and redesigning the applications with the most cutting-edge technologies to provide POS-integrated platform, automated decision-making at POR terminals and business intelligence analytic tools. IPC is a specialized division of InComm that provides product lifecycle tracking and returns management solutions for retailers and manufacturers.


100% Remote + CLT + Benefits (Health Insurance Coverage, Meal Vouchers, Annual Bonuses, and more!)


Responsibilities:

  • Designing, developing, and implementing scalable and robust applications using Java and the Spring framework (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data) and front-end framework like Vue JS.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including stakeholders, QA engineers, and product managers, to analyze issues, define requirements and deliver integrated solutions.
  • Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code, adhering to coding standards and best practices.
  • Creating and performing unit, integration, and system testing to ensure application quality and performance.
  • Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues in existing applications.
  • Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback to peers.
  • Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in the Spring ecosystem and JavaScipt communities.
  • Contributing to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Making technical and team decisions and assuming responsibility for those decisions while keeping management informed
  • Providing direction, motivating, and supporting a small group of individuals to achieve specific goals.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
  • 8+ years of proven experience in developing Java applications (1.8 and above), specifically with the Spring framework and Spring Boot in enterprise level scalable, distributed and fault tolerant environments.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases including SQL, stored procedures, and data modeling with MS SQL and/or Oracle.
  • Advanced knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 and Core JavaScript. Proficiency in at least one of modern front-end frameworks like Angular, React, and/or Vue.
  • Strong understanding of object relational mapping APIs like Hibernate, JPA and/or myBatis.
  • Practical understanding of developing Restful Microservices Services using Spring boot.
  • Proficient in version control, build management, and issue tracking software (i.e. git, Maven, JIRA)
  • Good working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and/or Windows server.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with containerization technologies and continuous delivery tools (e.g., Docker, Jenkins Pipeline, Kubernetes, Istio, ArgoCD and/or Snyk) is preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

We’re looking for a Billing & Customer Support Specialist to join our team! In this role, you’ll handle billing processes with precision and provide outstanding support to our clients, many of whom are navigating challenging immigration journeys

- Tech-savvy with experience using Microsoft Excel or similar tools.

- A positive attitude to contribute to a supportive work environment.


✨ Nice to Have:

- Experience in the legal or immigration sector.

- Familiarity with MyCase or similar case management software.

- Desire to grow within the company and commit to a long-term career.

description:

Estamos em busca de um Gestor de Projetos/Account para integrar nossa equipe, atendendo o mercado americano.

O candidato ideal deve ter experiência em gerenciar projetos de SEO e ser capaz de conduzir reuniões de forma eficaz, principalmente com clientes exigentes. A vaga é remota, com foco em resultados e eficiência.


Os maiores diferenciais que procuramos são:

Extremamente atento aos detalhes e analítico(a)

Pulso firme com equipe, garantindo prazo e qualidade das entregas

Relacionamento com cliente, alguém que passe a mão no telefone ligue e resolva

Perfil executor e resolutivo

Domínio de ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos como eKyte, Clickup


Responsabilidades :

  • Ser a ponte entre cliente e time, e o contato direto do cliente
  • Conduzir reuniões de onboarding / offboarding e acompanhamento mensal de resultados com os clientes.

  • Gerenciar o setup de projetos com time e cliente, com prazos de entrega de 15 dias.

  • Microgerenciar as pendências e prazos dos projetos, tanto com a equipe interna quanto com os clientes.
  • Elaborar relatórios detalhados de progresso e resultados, em colaboração com o time de Customer Success (CS).
  • Manter contato constante com os clientes, lidando com pendências e garantindo a satisfação.


Requisitos :

  • Experiência anterior em gestão de projetos, account manager e CS especialmente no atendimento a clientes com perfis desafiadores.
  • Perfil Comunicador/Analítico: Habilidade para articular ideias e tomar ações concretas para resolver problemas.
  • Experiência prévia na V4 Company será um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento e experiência em eKyte, será um diferencial
  • Capacidade de liderar e motivar equipes para garantir a entrega de resultados.
  • Organização e habilidade para controlar prazos e recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Experiência no acompanhamento de projetos detalhados, garantindo que todas as etapas sejam cumpridas com excelência.


Oferecemos :

  • Vaga PJ Remoto, com flexibilidade de horário.
  • Bonificação
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar com uma agência de SEO em crescimento, com foco no mercado americano.
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com grandes desafios e oportunidades de aprendizado constante.


Se você tem experiência sólida em gestão de projetos de SEO e está pronto para liderar equipes para a entrega de resultados, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Candidate-se agora!

title: Executivo de vendas de TI| Perfil Hunter
description:
LOUCOS POR INOVAÇÃO E TRANSFORMAÇÃO:

A .add é uma empresa de TI e inovação, com 25 anos no mercado. Estamos localizados em São Paulo , Rio de Janeiro e Miami .

Com atuação marcante no mercado brasileiro, desenvolvemos soluções eficientes de forma singular para entregar os melhores serviços e produtos nas áreas de Inovação e Tecnologia.

Nosso diferencial está na expertise de um time multidisciplinar e comprometido com as melhores práticas ágeis utilizadas para superar desafios corporativos e garantir resultados extraordinários com precisão, agilidade e segurança

Tecnologia, Liderança, Agilidade, Inovação e Pessoas, são os pontos que formam a essência da .add.

Aqui na .add você vai encontrar:

  • Ambiente colaborativo;
  • 100% Remoto;
  • Circuito de treinamentos;
  • Programa de Educação Continuada;
  • Desafios e oportunidades de crescimento
  • Oportunidade SP;

Resumo:

Buscamos um profissional engajado e motivado, com expectativas de crescimento pessoal e alinhamento ao desenvolvimento da empresa.

Será responsável pela gestão de uma carteira de clientes, atuando também no compartilhamento de conhecimento para o fortalecimento e desenvolvimento das equipes de vendas.

O candidato ideal terá excelência na prospecção, criação e fechamento de novas oportunidades, utilizando uma abordagem consultiva para identificar e qualificar leads, além de gerar negócios tanto com clientes novos quanto com a base já existente..

Como será seu dia a dia:

Atender e superar as metas de vendas

Criar negócios com sucesso a partir de contas de clientes novas e existentes

Gerenciar negociações complexas com executivos de nível sênior

Construir relacionamento e estabelecer relacionamentos de longo prazo com os clientes

Cota de 2 a 5 anos com experiência em vendas

Experiência e conhecimento prático de sistemas CRM

Histórico demonstrável de superação da cota

Fortes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal

Gerenciar carteira de clientes de acordo com as estratégias estabelecidas no planejamento da empresa.

Criar soluções estratégicas para o acompanhamento da carteira atual de clientes.

Fazer estudo de mercado e qualificação de novos leads.

Prospectar novos clientes, utilizando técnicas de negociação, de modo que suas expectativas sejam atendidas com sucesso.

Fazer follow-up com clientes e fornecedores internos.

Transmitir conhecimentos para os demais colaboradores das equipes comercial e negócios.

O que buscamos?

Pré-requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Necessária sólida experiência na área;
  • Experiência comercial na area de TI, industrias, e SAP
  • Possuir carteira de clientes
  • Vendas de serviços
  • Possuir conhecimento em técnicas de prospecção e vendas;
  • Bons conhecimentos no pacote Office, pois trabalhará com planilhas e apresentações;
  • Ter boa comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Habilidades:

  • Facilidade de comunicação, pois comunicar-se é a principal vertente do trabalho;
  • Perfil estratégico e inovador, porque é importante entender as necessidades dos clientes e como saná-las;
  • Ser organizado(a) e atento ao cumprimento de prazos e acordos.

Desejável:

  • Superior completo em Gestão de negócios, Administração comercial ou Gestão comercial;
  • Cursos de Estratégias de vendas e Gestão de vendas;

title: Product Owner
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Sobre a área:

A área de Produto Digital é responsável por evoluir os produtos da empresa, garantindo alta performance, experiência do usuário diferenciada e integração com os demais. Temos como objetivo aumentar a adoção, engajamento e satisfação dos usuários, assegurando entregas alinhadas às estratégias de negócio e à qualidade técnica esperada.


Principais atividades:

Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos.

Análise de mercado e Bench com identificação de tendências de aplicativos e canais digitais.

Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e critérios de aceitação claros.

Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras. Tomar decisões de Go/No Go da entrega na Review;

Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões

Conduzir refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas seguindo metodologias ágeis.

Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades junto aos usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.

Gerenciar os stakeholders e garantir a comunicação (estratégias e ações).



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Necessário graduação completa.

Necessário domínio do Pacote Office.

Necessário conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio a gestão de projetos e produtos.

Necessário conhecimento em Scrum e frameworks ágeis.

Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou posição similar, com atuação em produtos digitais.

Vivência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis (iOS e Android).

Habilidade em análise de métricas de produto (Firebase, App Store Connect, Google Play Console).

Boa comunicação e capacidade de articular diferentes áreas e stakeholders.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar na gestão de aplicativos digitais , com foco especial no aplicativo de resultados de exames , garantindo priorização assertiva das demandas e interlocução com diferentes áreas e regionais. Procuramos alguém com experiência avançada em aplicativos digitais , que seja articulada, saiba se posicionar com clareza e tenha facilidade em conduzir conversas estratégicas com diferentes públicos.

• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Escala: 5x2

Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
WE ARE HIRING DATA ENGINEER°

Offer 100% remotly ONLY Brazil

Direct contract with client


The Senior Cloud Data Engineer leads the design, architecture, and implementation of secure, scalable data solutions on AWS, utilizing Snowflake, dbt, and modern automation tools. This role drives best practices for data quality, validation, and governance, while optimizing performance and reliability across both cloud and legacy platforms. The Senior Cloud Data Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines and products, mentor junior engineers, and champions continuous improvement in engineering standards and operational excellence.


Responsabilities:

Leads the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, secure, and resilient data pipelines and systems on cloud platforms.

· Architects and implements advanced data integration solutions to support complex analytics, business intelligence, and enterprise reporting needs.

· Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, business analysts, product owners, and application engineers—to understand and deliver on evolving data requirements.

· Ensures the highest standards of data quality, integrity, and security through comprehensive testing, validation, and robust governance practices.

· Monitors, optimizes, and scales data workflows to achieve performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency targets across both cloud and legacy environments.

· Proactively identifies, investigates, and resolves data-related issues, providing technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members.

· Champions continuous improvement by staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, best practices, and by driving innovation in data engineering processes and solutions.

· Partners with enterprise architecture and data governance teams to define and enforce data standards and compliance requirements.

· Leads design reviews and technical workshops to uplevel engineering practices across the organization.

· Contributes to strategic planning for data platform evolution and modernization initiatives.


Skills:

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in data engineering, with a strong emphasis on designing and implementing cloud-based solutions.
  • · Advanced proficiency in SQL, with hands-on experience in both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
  • · Extensive experience architecting and operating data platforms on AWS and Azure; relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer Associate) strongly preferred.
  • · Deep knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, and enterprise data governance frameworks.
  • · Demonstrated success in leading and mentoring data engineering teams, driving technical excellence and fostering collaborative environments.
  • · Exceptional problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and proactively in fast-paced settings.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, orchestration, and data processing tasks within AWS environments.
  • · Outstanding communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration abilities, with a proven track record of partnering with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Expertise with Snowflake, dbt, GitHub, Control-M, and familiarity with modern data engineering frameworks (e.g., Airflow, Fivetran, Matillion) as deployed on AWS.
  • Solid understanding of both traditional on-premises (virtual/physical) and AWS cloud-based infrastructure, including Windows and Linux environments.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager LATAM
description:
About our company:


Werfen: Global Leader in In Vitro Diagnostics

Founded in 1966, Werfen is one of the world's leading companies in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of specialized diagnostic instruments, reagents, process automation solutions, and data management systems that empower patient care in hospitals and laboratories worldwide.

Our solutions in Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Autoimmunity, Transplantation, and Transfusion are available in over 100 countries and territories through our direct operations and distributors. We are a team of more than 7,000 employees with an annual revenue exceeding $2 billion , reflecting our global presence in the industry.


Position Summary:


The Talent Acquisition Manager LATAM will be responsible for leading the regional strategy for talent attraction and selection, ensuring structured, transparent, and business-aligned recruitment processes. The role’s mission is to build a standardized recruitment model for LATAM, guaranteeing quality, efficiency, compliance with KPIs, and alignment with Werfen’s culture, acting as a strategic partner to local and regional leaders. The objective is to strengthen the employer brand, attract high-performing talent who embody our values, and promote diversity and inclusion. The manager will serve as a strategic partner to the LATAM People Director and local leaders, ensuring that talent acquisition drives the company’s transformation and expertise in diagnostics.


Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition Strategy

  • Lead a unified LATAM recruitment strategy, aligned with global standards and local regulations.
  • Position Werfen as an employer of choice, promoting our culture, values, and purpose.
  • Drive fairness, transparency, and consistency across all hiring processes.

Recruitment Excellence & Innovation

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment with agility and strong candidate experience.
  • Integrate digital tools (ATS, AI, video interviews) to improve quality of hire.
  • Track key KPIs and ensure structured feedback for candidates and managers.

Employer Branding & Inclusion

  • Act as a Werfen brand ambassador, enhancing visibility in the healthcare sector.
  • Foster diversity, equity, and inclusion across all talent initiatives.
  • Strengthen partnerships with universities and professional networks.

Business Partnership & Insights

  • Partner with People BPs and leaders to align talent needs with business goals.
  • Provide data-driven insights and market intelligence for strategic decisions.
  • Champion onboarding excellence and post-hire follow-ups days).


Knowledge & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Additional certifications or training in Talent Management or Leadership are a plus.
  • 8–10 years of experience in recruitment, with 5+ years leading Talent Acquisition in a regional LATAM scope .
  • Experience in the healthcare, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical industry preferred.
  • Demonstrated success implementing standardized TA processes in multicultural environments.
  • Proficiency in digital recruitment tools, ATS platforms, assessments, and analytics .
  • Strong knowledge of LATAM labor markets and local recruitment regulations .


Core Competencies and Skills


  • Assertive communication and negotiation with candidates and leaders.
  • Results-oriented with a sense of urgency and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong influencing skills and change-agent mindset.
  • Relationship-building and collaboration across diverse teams.
  • Data-driven and strategic, translating insights into impactful actions.
  • Innovative and critical thinker with continuous improvement focus.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese (mandatory).

description:

Founded in 1966, Werfen is one of the world's leading companies in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of specialized diagnostic instruments, reagents, process automation solutions, and data management systems that empower patient care in hospitals and laboratories worldwide.

Our solutions in Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Autoimmunity, Transplantation, and Transfusion are available in over 100 countries and territories through our direct operations and distributors. title: Tech Lead
description:
Somos mais do que um software financeiro.


Nosso objetivo central é transformar a perspectiva das empresas em relação às finanças e operações corporativas . Já operamos um cartão de crédito PJ e estamos expandindo nosso portfólio com novos produtos de crédito como Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), capital de giro e antecipação de recebíveis.


Sobre o desafio


Estamos procurando uma pessoa Tech Lead para se juntar ao nosso time.


Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead para fortalecer nossa área de Tech.


Você busca um ambiente no qual fará parte de inovações desde o #Dia1 ? Quer ter opções de ações e fazer parte de uma startup bem capitalizada que está pronta para acelerar?


Se a resposta for sim , continue acompanhando os requisitos que fazem sentido para essa oportunidade.



️ O que esperamos de você nesta kaminhada:


  • Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead hands-on para liderar um time de 4/6 pessoas, atuando lado a lado com Produto e Negócio para transformar objetivos de business em soluções técnicas robustas. Você fará a ponte entre estratégia e execução: desenhar arquitetura , orientar o time , garantir qualidade/observabilidade e, quando fizer sentido, colocar a mão no código. Formato esperado: ~60% liderança/gestão e 40% técnico.

title: Especialista em Inteligência Artificial e Automação de Processos
description:
A Mayresse Arquitetura  está em busca de um(a) profissional com olhar inovador e mentalidade estratégica para integrar nosso time de tecnologia e inovação!


Estamos em uma fase de expansão e transformação digital , e procuramos alguém capaz de desenvolver soluções inteligentes que otimizem fluxos de trabalho, automatizem rotinas e aprimorem a experiência das pessoas nos processos internos e de atendimento.


Este(a) especialista será responsável por desenhar e implementar automações, estruturar fluxos de relacionamento e aplicar inteligência artificial em diferentes frentes do negócio.


Buscamos um perfil que una raciocínio analítico, curiosidade criativa e domínio técnico — alguém que enxergue a IA como ferramenta de transformação real e não apenas como tendência .


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com automação de processos e integrações entre plataformas.
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Make, Zapier ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento em IA generativa (como ChatGPT e ferramentas correlatas).
  • Boa comunicação, pensamento sistêmico e foco em eficiência.
  • Perfil autônomo, colaborativo e orientado a resultados.


Por que fazer parte da Mayresse?

Somos um escritório de arquitetura e construção residencial com mais de 20 anos de atuação. Unimos arquitetura e inovação para criar novas formas de viver e conviver para nossos clientes!


Se você é movido por desafios e acredita que a inteligência artificial pode nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das famílias através do morar, esse é o seu lugar!


Envie seu currículo ou perfil profissional + pretensão salarial para 

 com o assunto “Especialista em IA – Mayresse”.

title: Fullstack - Vue / Nuxt - Developer
description:
POSITION: Fullstack Developer - Vue / Nuxt
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

AtlasIntel seeks talented Fullstack Engineers with a focus on frontend development . If you excel at building sleek, user-friendly interfaces and solving complex problems , you’ll thrive on our team. We value candidates with a strong algorithmic foundation , analytical prowess , and a proactive mindset .

Our ideal engineers are self-starters who can handle dynamic, fast-paced environments , manage multiple projects , and embrace learning new technologies. You’ll collaborate with designers , engineers , and stakeholders to drive the next generation of our platforms and tools.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Fullstack Engineer, you will

  • Develop robust APIs for various applications.
  • Build cross-platform, responsive websites with intuitive interfaces.
  • Design and manage high-performance, scalable database solutions .
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Optimize web applications for maximum speed and performance.
  • Implement data visualization and other interactive media elements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, contributing to both development and strategic discussions.
  • Participate in code reviews , testing , and quality control.
  • Stay curious and continuously learn new technologies to improve your craft.


WHAT YOU BRING

We’re looking for candidates with the following skills:

  • Proficiency with Node.js .
  • Strong expertise in JavaScript (ES6) , HTML5 , CSS , and preprocessors.
  • Experience developing web apps using Vue/Nuxt .
  • Great SQL skills for data management and optimization.
  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and how to integrate with them.
  • Experience with Git and software version control best practices.
  • Strong organizational skills , attention to detail , and an ability to learn quickly.


NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

While not required, experience with the following technologies will give you a competitive edge:

  • Python , Java , or Scala
  • D3.js or other data visualization libraries
  • AWS Cloud services and architecture


ABOUT US

AtlasIntel is a fast-growing tech startup headquartered in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. Our cutting-edge polling and market research tools have established us as the most accurate pollster for both the 2024 and 2020 US presidential elections. Founded by two Harvard PhDs, we specialize in real-time data collection and analytics that fuel dashboards with insights spanning economics, politics, culture, and society. Join us and help shape the future of data-driven intelligence.


WHY ATLASINTEL?
  • Be part of a mission-driven company that’s revolutionizing the polling industry.
  • Collaborate with a diverse and talented team of engineers, designers, and data scientists.
  • Work in a dynamic environment where innovation and learning are encouraged.
  • Contribute to products that have real-world impact on business, politics, and society.

﻿

APPLY TODAY!

Join us on our journey to shape the future of polling and market research. Reach out to us at or visit our website at for more information.

  • Build cross-platform, responsive websites with intuitive interfaces.
  • Design and manage high-performance, scalable database solutions .
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Optimize web applications for maximum speed and performance.
  • Implement data visualization and other interactive media elements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, contributing to both development and strategic discussions.
  • Participate in code reviews , testing , and quality control.
  • Stay curious and continuously learn new technologies to improve your craft.


WHAT YOU BRING

We’re looking for candidates with the following skills:

  • Proficiency with Node.js .
  • Strong expertise in JavaScript (ES6) , HTML5 , CSS , and preprocessors.
  • Experience developing web apps using Vue/Nuxt .
  • Great SQL skills for data management and optimization.
  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and how to integrate with them.
  • Experience with Git and software version control best practices.
  • Strong organizational skills , attention to detail , and an ability to learn quickly.


NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

While not required, experience with the following technologies will give you a competitive edge:

  • Python , Java , or Scala
  • D3.js or other data visualization libraries
  • AWS Cloud services and architecture


ABOUT US

AtlasIntel is a fast-growing tech startup headquartered in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. Our cutting-edge polling and market research tools have established us as the most accurate pollster for both the 2024 and 2020 US presidential elections. Founded by two Harvard PhDs, we specialize in real-time data collection and analytics that fuel dashboards with insights spanning economics, politics, culture, and society. Join us and help shape the future of data-driven intelligence.


WHY ATLASINTEL?
  • Be part of a mission-driven company that’s revolutionizing the polling industry.
  • Collaborate with a diverse and talented team of engineers, designers, and data scientists.
  • Work in a dynamic environment where innovation and learning are encouraged.
  • Contribute to products that have real-world impact on business, politics, and society.

﻿

APPLY TODAY!

Join us on our journey to shape the future of polling and market research. Reach out to us at or visit our website at for more information.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência prática em UX Design.

Domínio de ferramentas de design e prototipação (Figma).

Vivência com métodos de pesquisa de usabilidade e análise de comportamento do usuário.

Capacidade de traduzir insights em soluções de design claras e funcionais.

Atuação em projetos digitais (web e mobile).

Experiência com Design System, identidade visual e criação de componentes.


CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!
